{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Treatment response in non-injected target lesions' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Treatment response in non-injected target lesions based on RECIST v1.1 by BICR",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This secondary endpoint is listed but no corresponding statistical analysis is described in Section 9. The exploratory analyses mention noninjected target lesions but only under itRECIST, not RECIST v1.1 by BICR.",
      "fix": "Add a specific analysis for this endpoint in the Statistical Methods section, including the estimand and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Blood concentrations of CMP-001 or its metabolites",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed but no PK analysis methods are described in Section 9. The sample size section mentions PK samples from 20 subjects but no analysis plan.",
      "fix": "Add a PK analysis subsection describing the derivation of PK parameters and statistical methods."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoint 'Development of anti-Qb antibodies' lacks a stated analysis",
      "quote": "Development of anti-Qb antibodies",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in Section 9.",
      "fix": "Add an immunogenicity analysis subsection."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint estimand lacks intercurrent event handling and summary measure details",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint of the study is the ORR, defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of CR or PR based on RECIST v1.1 as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR).",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: no strategy for intercurrent events (e.g., death, discontinuation, subsequent therapy) and no explicit summary measure (e.g., proportion with 95% CI) is stated.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand attributes in the SAP or protocol, including intercurrent event handling and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size inconsistency: 69 vs 100 subjects and missing justification for 100",
      "quote": "A sample size of 69 subjects achieves at least 80% power to detect a difference of 13% using a 2-sided exact test with a significance level of 0.05, assuming that the null hypothesis for ORR is 7% (Hodi-2016; Ribas-2018), and the study ORR is 20%. The sample size was increased to 100 subjects to adjust for an early discontinuation rate of 15% and to allow for a robust assessment of safety.",
      "page": 80,
      "section": "9.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size section states 69 subjects for power but then says increased to 100 for discontinuation and safety. However, the 15% discontinuation adjustment would yield 69/(1-0.15)=81, not 100. The additional 19 subjects are not justified by a stated rationale.",
      "fix": "Clarify the rationale for the increase from 69 to 100, or adjust the power calculation to match the final sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for secondary endpoint 'ORR, DOR, and PFS based on RECIST v1.1 and iRECIST by Investigator assessment'",
      "quote": "ORR, DOR, and PFS based on RECIST v1.1 and immune objective response rate, immune duration of response (iDOR), and immune progression-free survival (iPFS) based on iRECIST by Investigator assessment",
      "page": 33,
      "section": "2.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "This composite secondary endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in Section 9. The efficacy analyses section mentions ITT but does not specify these investigator-assessed endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection in Efficacy Analyses to describe the analysis of these endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory endpoint 'Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 and other cytokines'",
      "quote": "Change from Baseline in blood concentrations of CXCL10 (interferon gamma-induced protein 10) and other cytokines after treatment with CMP-001",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "This exploratory endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in Section 9. The pharmacodynamic analyses section mentions biomarkers but not specifically CXCL10 or cytokines.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for this endpoint in the exploratory analyses section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing analysis for exploratory endpoint 'Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers'",
      "quote": "Baseline, and change from Baseline, in tumor or blood measurements of biomarkers related to TLR9, immune checkpoints, and potential markers of resistance or response to immunotherapy",
      "page": 34,
      "section": "2.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "This exploratory endpoint is listed but no analysis is described in Section 9. The exploratory tumor biopsy analyses section mentions biomarkers but does not specify the statistical methods.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the analysis for this endpoint in the exploratory analyses section."
    }
  ]
}
